title: TESS calibrated full-frame images, read as cutouts through MAST's TESScut service

links.label: TESS calibrated full-frame images: all sectors

evidence.locator: TESScut: the same pixels cut out of every full-frame image of a sector at one place on the sky, as a FITS cube.

statements.text: This work includes data collected by the TESS mission, funded by the NASA Explorer Program, obtained from the Mikulski Archive for Space Telescopes (MAST).
